visualRisks.description: Water edges abruptly without a smooth transition.
House and dock placement may be confusing due to similar colors.

navigationRisks.description: The route path includes a sudden jump from row 64 to 76, which might be jarring for players.
There are no visual cues indicating the end of the route or the start of a new section.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Add markers or landmarks at significant points in the route.
